definitions.relative_norm: ||candidate-reference|| / max(||reference||, 1e-300), except point error denominator max(1,||x_star||). Absolute-vs-relative denominators are explicit in each output.
definitions.unbounded_stationarity: ||g_physical||inf; inference-box feasibility is not required for an explicitly unbounded method.
definitions.library_status: Always save success/status/message/nfev/njev and classify failures/budgets. Scientific stationarity is audited externally, independently of method stopping flags. A false library success flag is not rewritten; external stationarity may be reported as externally qualified with library failure. Any uncompleted fit is a failed required fit.
definitions.rank: SVD of sqrt(W)*K with physical parameter scales one and relative tolerance1e-10; regularization rows never increase reported data rank.

required_case65: All17 declared fits complete, raw state/candidate/iteration history retained; FINAL residuals of completed forward solves meet the limit. Retained intermediate Newton residuals are not convergence decisions.
Every completed bounded fit feasible and physical projected-gradient <=1e-7; every unbounded fit physical gradient <=1e-7.

Every fit objective agrees with its independently Thomas-based context reference within objective-gap bound. Active context has at least one active box constraint within1e-6; KKT, not recovery of infeasible truth.

For each context with unbounded methods, the common Thomas-TRF reference must be strictly inside both physical box bounds AND have unbounded physical-gradient infinity norm<=oracle_stationarity_inf before use. No such common comparator is claimed for active-box context.
All fixed same-theta dense/Thomas state and Jacobian comparisons pass; sensitivity finite difference is an additional control, not sole reference.
One-center data rank<=1, with separate augmented curvature rank. All objective gamma and algorithm mu histories distinct.
required_case66: All16 declared fits complete and finite; analytic quadratic/Rosenbrock final-point/objective/gradient limits pass.
Every accepted own step satisfies explicitly evaluated strong Wolfe with c1/c2; curvature exceeds frozen relative guard. No Armijo-only rescue.
Each full inverse-BFGS update is SPD and meets raw antisymmetry limit; explicit symmetric representation is not eigenvalue repair.
Each own L-BFGS direction agrees with independent dense CURRENT-gammaI/retained<=3-pair chronological replay to relative1e-10.
Empty/one/full/eviction fixtures, wrong-gradient and negative-curvature controls detect their intended faults; counts/storage are actual.
required_case67: All42 declared fits complete, finite, feasible and satisfy physical projected-gradient<=1e-7; incomplete paths remain explicitly unselected and fail completeness.
Stored standardized noise is exactly reused as specified; every path checks all5 gammas before selection.
Every selected gamma exactly matches finite-list largest-admissible rule; no-admissible/incomplete categories are distinct and tested.
Fixed-gamma linear-control covariance/bias/discrepancy propagation agree with independent scalar2x2 algebra within1e-10rel; symmetry/PSD checked.
At nonlinear selected interior/rank2 fits, covariance/ellipse is finite and PSD; otherwise N/A with reason. No mandatory truth coverage or universal monotonic truth-error reduction.
Matched and fine-data model discrepancies, weak-direction curvature and bias are quantitative recorded diagnostics. The small ensemble is not a coverage or risk theorem.
note_on_counts: Exact collected test/gate counts and literal source call graph must be frozen and reviewed again after implementation and before any numerical command; this design contract does not authorize imports or execution.
